answer: An effective defense is stake-backed reputation tied to one identity kernel: each agent must lock a deposit and earn trust only through graded, useful work over time. A new identity starts at zero, cannot buy standing, and cannot transfer reputation. Like bees guarding nectar, peers check work before rewarding it; a pearl of earned standing grows slowly, while an oasis of fake identities cannot shortcut the process because every fake must separately pay the deposit, do the work, and pass independent grading. Creating many sybils therefore multiplies cost, while an honest agent pays only once.
